scope: Seven selected existing cases from the complete157-case Modules browser run, not additional tests. Synthetic service/identity controls cover cross-mode history, shared styles, client and organization replacement, interrupted writes, expiry, sign-out and request-scope reset.

cases.title: shared product navigation and history preserve verified client hints and scoped styles
client replacement interrupts a write and organization replacement clears drafts and revalidates
Core expiry clears the application, does not replay and cannot be escaped by changing client
missing configuration renders setup without issuing service requests
org/session change clears prior records and sign-out removes all protected content
401 removes protected content and asks for sign-in without replaying a request
development StrictMode remount establishes a valid request scope before child reads
